ينهرس (form VII)
# يَنْهَرِسُ (yanharisu) /jan.ha.ri.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
# يَنْهَرِسَ (yanharisa) /jan.ha.ri.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
# يَنْهَرِسْ (yanharis) /jan.ha.ris/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْهَرَسَ (inharasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
